name: CloudPassage Halo
description: The Sumo Logic App for CloudPassage Halo helps you detect security violations and look for threats across your complex infrastructure by analyzing massive volumes of Halo event data. CloudPassage Halo platform records over 80 different types of security events about your Halo-managed infrastructure, whether you deploy into public cloud environments or your private data center. These events deliver information about your infrastructure and include critical security alerts for firewall changes, access changes, configuration changes, and file integrity changes, and more. This app enables security operators and administrators to correlate security events across their Halo-managed infrastructure.

children.name: CloudPassage Halo - Critical Events
children.description: View critical issues for the last 24 hours, outliers for the critical issues threshold during that time, and compare today's critical issues and outliers with the previous day.

panels.name: Critical Issues Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| parse regex field=metrics "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| timeslice 5m
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues  by _timeslice

panels.name: Critical Issues Outlier
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| parse regex field=metrics "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| timeslice 5m
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues  by _timeslice
| outlier count_issues

panels.name: Outlier on Delta (today - yesterday) of Critical Issues
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| parse regex field=metrics "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| timeslice 5m

//| formatDate(_messageTime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as messageDate
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues_today  by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift 1d as vs_yesterday
// create a delta field that represents the difference between historical data and current data
|(count_issues_today - count_issues_today_vs_yesterday) as delta
// use an Outlier to statistically monitor spikes or dips in the delta
| outlier delta threshold = 2, window = 5

children.name: CloudPassage Halo - Overview
children.description: View counts of key information for you system as well as top and bottom 10 processes for Linux, top and bottom 10 services for Windows, and top and bottom 10 software vulnerabilities found by Cloud Passage Halo.

panels.name: Critical Issues
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues 
| toInt(count_issues)
| format("%d", count_issues) as count_issues

panels.name: Active Server Counts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "servers_by_state_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field= _first "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"state\": \"active\"" multi
| sum(true_count1) as server_counter
| toInt(server_counter)
| format("%d", server_counter) as server_counter

panels.name: Number of OS Types
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "os_types_summary"
| parse regex "\"os_types_summary\": \{\"count\": (?<num_of_os_types>\d*),"
| first(num_of_os_types) as os_counter
| toInt(os_counter)
| format("%d", os_counter) as os_counter

panels.name: Number of Processes

_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo 
| parse regex "\"processes_summary\": \{\"count\": (?<num_of_processes>\d*),"
| first (num_of_processes) as proc_counter
| toInt(proc_counter)
| format("%d", proc_counter) as proc_counter

panels.name: Number of User Accounts

_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "local_accounts_summary"
| parse regex "\"local_accounts_summary\": \{\"count\": (?<num_of_local_accounts>\d*),"
| first(num_of_local_accounts)  as acct_counter
| toInt(acct_counter)
| format("%d", acct_counter) as acct_counter

panels.name: Non Critical Issues
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"

| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": false" multi

panels.name: Number of Software Packages
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "sw_packages_summary"

panels.name: Critical Issues Delta Over 10 Minutes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues 
| toInt(count_issues)
| format("%d", count_issues) as count_issues
| compare timeshift -10m
| count_issues - count_issues_10m as difference
| toInt(difference)
| format("%d", difference) as difference
| concat (count_issues, "(delta = ", difference, ")") as critical_issue_delta_over_10Mins
| fields critical_issue_delta_over_10Mins

panels.name: All Halo Related Metrics Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo 
| timeslice 1m 
| count by _timeslice 
| smooth _count,10 as moving_avg

panels.name: Linux Top 10 Processes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "processes_summary" "process_name" "os_type"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"processes_summary\"\: \{\"count\": [0-9]+, \"servers\": (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<count_proc>[0-9]+), \"os_type\": \"linux\", \"process_name\": \"(?<proc_name>\w+)\"" multi
| count by count_proc, proc_name
| top 10 proc_name by count_proc

panels.name: Linux Bottom 10 Processes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo  "processes_summary" "process_name"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"processes_summary\"\: \{\"count\": [0-9]+, \"servers\": (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<count_proc>[0-9]+), \"os_type\": \"linux\", \"process_name\": \"(?<proc_name>\w+)\"" multi
| count by proc_name, count_proc 
| number(count_proc)
| sort by count_proc asc
| fields - _count
| limit 10

| count by svc_name, count_svc
| top 10 svc_name by count_svc

panels.name: Bottom 10 SW Vulnerabilities
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "sw_vulnerability_summary" "rule_key"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"sw_vulnerability_summary\"\: \{\"count\": [0-9]+, \"issues\": (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| first(metrics)
| parse regex field=_first "\"count\": (?<vuln_sw_counter>\d+), \"name\": \"(?<vuln_sw_name>[^,]*)\", \"rule_key\": [^,]*, \"critical\": (?<criticality>\w+)," multi
| count by vuln_sw_name, vuln_sw_counter
| number(vuln_sw_counter)
| sort by vuln_sw_counter asc
| fields - _count
| limit 10

panels.name: Top 10 SW Vulnerabilities

| count by vuln_sw_counter, vuln_sw_name
| top 10 vuln_sw_name by vuln_sw_counter

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Cloudpassage/Halo "current_issues_by_criticality_summary"
| parse regex "\"log\": \{\"(?<metric_type>\w*)\"\: (?<metrics>.*)\}"
| parse regex field=metrics "\"count\": (?<true_count1>[0-9]+), \"critical\": true" multi
| timeslice 5m
| sum(true_count1) as count_issues  by _timeslice
| outlier count_issues
| where count_issues_violation =1
